theme_archetype.description: Architectural Digest meets custom cottage country craftsmanship. Premium, editorial, high-end. Clean, minimal, warm, and confident.

primary.name: Deep Navy / Dark Green
primary.usage: Headers, footer, background for dark sections, primary high-contrast surfaces.

secondary.name: Charcoal Black
secondary.usage: Body text, secondary dark backgrounds, deep borders.

accent.name: Forest Green
accent.usage: CTAs, highlights, underlines, hover states, active indicators.

neutral.name: Warm Off-White
neutral.usage: Page backgrounds, light sections, card backgrounds to maintain a warm editorial feel.

accent_secondary.name: Soft Gold
accent_secondary.usage: Subtle neutral accent, borders, decorative eyebrow text, star ratings.

white.name: Pure White
white.usage: Text on dark backgrounds, pristine contrast elements.

headings.styles: Elegant, confident. Tracking should be tight (tracking-tight) for large headers.
headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large pull quotes.

body.styles: Clean, highly legible. leading-relaxed for body copy.

eyebrow.styles: Uppercase, wide letter-spacing (tracking-[0.2em]), text-sm or text-xs.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous whitespace. Containers must have breathing room to establish luxury.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00a34f] text-white hover:bg-[#01261d] transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm
buttons.secondary_dark: border-2 border-[#00a34f] text-[#00a34f] hover:bg-[#00a34f] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm
buttons.secondary_light: border border-[#231f20] text-[#231f20] hover:bg-[#231f20] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm

navigation.style: Sticky header that transitions on scroll. Transparent background with white text at the top over the hero image, transitioning to solid #01261d with white text on scroll. Mobile hamburger overlay.
navigation.links: Hover state: text-[#00a34f] or an underline animation.

cards.services: bg-[#01261d] text-white p-12 border border-white/10 hover:border-[#00a34f]/50 transition-all duration-300
cards.team: Minimalist card with grayscale or duotone avatar, clean typography below. No border, solid transparent or #F9F7F4 background.
cards.testimonial: bg-[#01261d] text-white p-10 lg:p-16 text-center italic font-serif text-2xl

form.style: Floating labels, minimalist bottom-border only or very clean outlined inputs.
form.focus: Focus state strictly uses #00a34f (border and floating label color).
form.dropdown: Custom styled to match minimal inputs.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Subtle scroll fade-in and slight translate-y animations for all major sections to feel cinematic.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Images in galleries scale up slightly (scale-105) on hover with a slow transition (duration-700).
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Color transitions with a solid, unhurried pace.

hero_featured.description: Blue cottage exterior with timber porch. Use as the main Home page hero.
Great room interior with wood beams + bar. Use as About Us or Process hero.

supplemental_unsplash.description: Luxury waterfront mansion with private dock
Room with wooden ceiling and chandelier - suitable for dark overlay
Peaceful pine trees by Kawartha Lakes
Living room filled with furniture and a fireplace
Interior vintage styled room with fireplace

instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react for UI icons (chevron, hamburger menu) and thin, elegant icons for the services grid.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Ensure multi-page navigation is wired up correctly (Home, Our Process, About Us, Contact Us) utilizing React Router or similar.
instructions_to_main_agent.form_behavior: Implement floating labels using CSS peer classes (e.g., peer-focus, peer-placeholder-shown) combined with Tailwind. Ensure focus border color is exactly #00a34f.
instructions_to_main_agent.hero_overlay: Use a subtle gradient or flat color overlay (e.g., bg-[#01261d]/40) on hero images to ensure text readability while maintaining the high-end imagery.
instructions_to_main_agent.team_cards: Use elegant, monochrome or muted placeholders for team members if no real photos are available.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_architecture: Build functional React components for Sections (Hero, Foundation, ServicesGrid, GalleryMasonry, ExperienceBanner, Testimonial, ProcessSteps). Use clean HTML/Tailwind for layouts over generic UI wrappers to maintain the editorial masonry styling.
